en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a wooden villa or summer house in a snowy coastal or lakeside landscape. The house has a steep metal roof with a small tower, decorative wooden balcony and porch railings, and is set at the edge of a pine forest. A person stands on the front steps. In the distance, a small boathouse or shed stands near the water. The main image is bordered by a dark frame, and beneath it is a modern color calibration chart and ruler, indicating the card has been digitized for archival purposes. No original printed caption or handwriting is visible on the postcard side of the image.
